name: Freeman EA
summary: The Freeman EA is a trend-following expert advisor that uses moving average crossovers and momentum indicators to identify and ride market trends. It enters positions when short-term momentum aligns with the prevailing trend direction and employs trailing stops to protect profits. The EA systematically manages trades with predefined risk parameters and trend-confirmation filters.
summary_zh: Freeman EA是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，利用移动平均线交叉和动量指标来识别并跟随市场趋势。当短期动量与主要趋势方向一致时开仓，并使用追踪止损来保护利润。该EA通过预定义的风险参数和趋势确认过滤器来系统性地管理交易。
strategy_analysis: Freeman EA的核心策略是基于趋势跟踪理念，通过移动平均线的金叉和死叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件要求短期均线上穿长期均线（做多）或下穿（做空），同时需要动量指标（如RSI或MACD）确认趋势强度，避免在震荡行情中错误入场。出场条件包括固定止损、固定止盈以及追踪止损机制，当价格回撤超过设定幅度时自动平仓锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，确保每笔交易的风险可控。资金管理方面，EA设置了最大持仓限制和单日最大亏损限额，防止极端行情下账户遭受过大损失。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The Freeman EA's core strategy is based on trend-following principles, using moving average crossovers (golden cross and death cross) to determine trend direction. Entry conditions require the short-term MA crossing above the long-term MA for buy signals or below for sell signals, with momentum indicators (such as RSI or MACD) confirming trend strength to avoid false entries in ranging markets. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss, fixed take-profit, and a trailing stop mechanism that automatically closes positions when price retraces beyond a set threshold to lock in profits. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based calculation relative to account balance, ensuring controlled risk per trade. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and daily loss caps to prevent excessive account drawdown during extreme market conditions. The overall strategy logic is clear, but may generate frequent false signals in choppy or ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: Close orders with specified magic number (-1=all)

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，趋势跟踪是经过长期验证的有效方法
具有多层出场机制（止损、止盈、追踪止损），风险控制较为完善
使用动量指标作为趋势过滤器，减少震荡市中的虚假信号
参数化设计良好，用户可以根据不同市场环境调整参数
魔术编号管理订单，避免与其他EA冲突
pros_en: Clear strategy logic — trend following is a well-validated approach over long periods
Multi-layer exit mechanism (stop-loss, take-profit, trailing stop) provides robust risk control
Momentum indicator filter reduces false signals in ranging/choppy markets
Well-parameterized design allows users to adjust settings for different market conditions
Magic number ensures order management isolation from other EAs
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和连续亏损
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下止损可能被频繁触发
固定止损止盈没有考虑市场波动率（ATR），在不同波动环境下适应性不足
缺少多时间框架确认，单一周期信号可能不够可靠
cons_en: Trend-following strategy prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks new bar check mechanism — may open duplicate positions on the same candle
No spread filter — stop-losses may be frequently triggered in high-spread environments
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit don't account for market volatility (ATR), reducing adaptability across varying volatility regimes
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation — single timeframe signals may be insufficiently reliable
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动率自适应调整止损距离
添加多时间框架确认逻辑，例如在H4趋势方向确认后才在H1入场
增加震荡行情识别过滤器（如ADX指标），在低趋势强度时暂停交易
实现新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线上重复开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that adapts to current market volatility
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation logic — e.g., only enter on H1 when H4 trend direction agrees
Add a ranging market filter (e.g., ADX indicator) to pause trading during low-trend-strength periods
Implement new bar check to prevent duplicate position openings on the same candle

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查，可能在同一K线上多次开仓导致过度持仓
固定止损未考虑市场波动率，低波动时止损过远浪费利润空间，高波动时止损过近容易被扫
没有点差过滤，在流动性较差时段交易成本可能过高
趋势跟踪策略本身在震荡行情中存在系统性亏损风险
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check — may open multiple positions on the same candle leading to overexposure
Fixed stop-loss doesn't account for volatility — too wide in low-vol and too tight in high-vol environments
No spread filter — trading costs may be excessive during low-liquidity sessions
Trend-following strategy inherently carries systematic loss risk during ranging/choppy markets
